title: Beauty and the Beast Girl
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A lonely monster girl living hidden in a forest wishes she could live among humans despite her frightening appearance (Seven Seas blurb). A blind human girl begins visiting her, and the two grow attached in their secluded world until their bond becomes love. A single-volume yuri fantasy, first a webcomic.
life_message: Love sees past appearances; being truly known by another heals loneliness.
